name: example-skill-interface-design
title: Craft-First SaaS Dashboard
description: Product-interface dashboard built with design-team craft: decided visual hierarchy (one focal point, weight-over-size type tiers, tabular numerals), whisper-quiet surface elevation, low-opacity rgba borders, sidebar on the canvas background, inset inputs, domain-derived palette and token names, and a signature data element instead of generic metric boxes. Use when the brief mentions "dashboard", "admin panel", "SaaS app", "ops console", "monitoring UI", "data interface", "settings page". Based on Dammyjay93's interface-design skill.

query.en: Design a dark ops dashboard for a solar fleet monitoring SaaS with a clear focal metric and quiet layered surfaces.
